head: codex/failure-terminal-consumers-20261012
title: fix: authenticate terminal failure in downstream recovery consumers
body:
A naturally failed Assurance cannot currently recover the original PR #2655 terminal debt: the downstream exact-main consumer still requires causal-only provenance, rejects failed artifact transport, compares a string parent ID with a numeric run ID, and demands a successful push Assurance even when its only operating failure is that same terminal debt. The Direct Owner post-merge consumer also rejects the actual two failed observation steps.

This change authenticates the preserved failure across those consumers. It permits only the sole Assurance failure with the exact original run/artifact/ZIP tuple, 27 successful deep controls, sealed audit and operating-proof content, native first-attempt run/job binding, and actual physical ZIP verification. External-clock audit upstream remains null; the independently authenticated parent supplies the Sentinel binding. The normal success path stays strict. Failure remains VERIFIED_FAIL, grants no authority, and cannot establish normal operating terminal, whole-platform completion or promotion.

Validation: 95 targeted Node tests passed; independent Red Team ran 33 tests and replayed the actual protected-main push ZIP 11717775110 (94b671085bbf4eee8e035666cd0a8f434a60ab8828e6226359e741c44c4b839f). The new consumer accepts landing-integrity evidence while keeping authority false. Native PR CI is pending; no controller rerun or runtime dispatch is requested.

Runtime limitations: original consistent ledger row/immutable terminal and two full natural authority generations remain unverified. Natural Coverage run38181366238 failed with GitHub installation API HTTP403 rate-limit exhaustion; this source correction does not claim quota restoration. Current main is 5837440e27a2c93d76a1414b8411a765a113ed22. Original terminal-null CONSUMED must never be reconsumed. #1677/#2214 remain read-only reconciliation. Rollback is revert of this bounded development change.

Principles: autonomous_effect=restore bounded natural failure-terminal recovery; global_effect=preserve existing producer scope without provider activation; irreplaceable_value_effect=preserve original immutable identity and provenance; transparency_effect=retain actual failures and source/digest bindings. Production/Public/G5/provider HOLD remain in force.
